One item is deliberately unfinished: the opening card the owner disliked needs a NEW card, so three look-preview prompts went to the owner and no code was written. Routed to plan 177; the cue is left as authored rather than swapping out a card the owner asked for one round earlier. (2) z01 had silently reverted from the owner-approved enacted/promise-shelf back to slate/kinetic-sentence. They are inert (the manifest names exact files) but they are also the only signal that a cue silently changed, which argues for a gate rather than a cleanup. (5) plans/README.md registers 175-vf2-per-cue-frame-gate with no plan file behind it, and that is precisely the gate that would have caught the c27 overflow.
